description: Decompose budget, forecast, and period variances into reconciled drivers with sign conventions and management commentary.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $variance-analysis to explain these actual-versus-budget results.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill variance-analysis --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill variance-analysis --agent codex --global

examples: Decompose revenue variance into price and volume effects.
Extract this authorized report and draft variance commentary.
notes: Call sandbase_inspect before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Use tool_name as a discovery hint with sandbase_discover; pass the matching returned name to sandbase_inspect and follow execute_as with the current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Extract requested structured fields from a selected page.
Read a selected page as clean Markdown.
